title: Input bit as a word
statement: For a natural-number word width $W$, a Boolean list $x$, and an integer position $p$, the corresponding word is $1$ exactly when $p$ is nonnegative and the bit of $x$ at position $p$ is true; otherwise it is $0$. A position beyond the list is treated as false.
